pr.title: fix: remove stream hedged requests
pr.body:
## Summary

- remove the stream hedged-request executor path so stream candidates run serially
- remove hedge-only cancellation reason plumbing, stream drop classification, and hedge delay timing
- keep stream watchdog, timing metrics, and serial failover behavior intact

## Root Cause

Stream hedging launched a backup candidate while the primary stream was still pending. That could send multiple upstream requests for one client request and consume extra upstream tokens before the loser was cancelled.

## Validation

- `cargo fmt --all --check`
- `timeout 60s cargo test -p hook_backend proxy::executor`
- `timeout 60s cargo test -p hook_backend proxy::attempt_log`
- `timeout 60s cargo test -p hook_backend proxy::stream_transport`
- `timeout 60s cargo test -p hook_backend proxy::timeout`
- `just check`
- `rg --hidden -n "hedge|Hedged|HEDGED|stream_hedge|hedge_cancelled|hedge_loser|HedgeCancelled|HedgedBackup|CANDIDATE_CANCEL_REASONS|mark_candidate_cancel_reason|take_candidate_cancel_reason|clear_candidate_cancel_reason|StartedCandidateTask|execute_hedged_stream_candidates|cancel_hedged_loser" apps/hook_backend/src apps/hook_frontend/src crates --glob '!target/**' --glob '!.git/**'`
